memories.name: Agent Memory
memories.description: When and how agents read and update their persistent native memory
memories.instructions:
## Agent Memory

Your persistent memory lives in `~/.claude/projects/<path>/memory/`. Claude Code reads it automatically at session start.

### Structure

- **`MEMORY.md`** - Index file. Loaded into *every* session (200-line / ~25 KB limit). Keep it as a pointer list. Entries past 200 lines are truncated.
- **Topic files** (`*.md`) - Detail files (e.g. `user_role.md`, `feedback_testing.md`). Loaded on-demand when relevant. Store depth here, not in MEMORY.md.

### File format

Each topic file:
```markdown
---
name: short-kebab-slug
description: one-line summary
metadata:
  type: user | feedback | project | reference
---

Body content here.
```

MEMORY.md - one line per entry:
```markdown
- [Title](file.md) - one-line hook
```

### When to save

Save when you learn something non-obvious that would help future sessions:
- User preferences, role, expertise (type: user)
- Corrections or confirmed approaches: avoid X, always do Y (type: feedback)
- Project context not in code/git: deadlines, stakeholder decisions, why (type: project)
- Where things live in external systems: Slack, dashboards, Linear (type: reference)

Do NOT save:
- Things derivable from code or git history
- Ephemeral task state or in-progress work
- Duplicates - update existing entries instead
- Anything already in CLAUDE.md files

### When to update

- End of a session where you learned something worth keeping
- When the user corrects you
- When you discover project context the user has not written down
- When you find where something lives in an external system

### Discipline

- MEMORY.md stays under 200 lines. Consolidate if it grows past ~150.
- One file per topic - do not dump everything in MEMORY.md body.
- Link topic files from MEMORY.md with [[name]] cross-references.
- Stale memories rot - update or remove when things change.

memories.name: Workspace Rules
memories.description: Git workflow, task management, GitHub access tiers, and safety rules — injected into all agents
memories.instructions:
## Workspace Rules

### Git Workflow

- **Never push directly to main.** Always create a feature branch first.
- Branch names: `<agent-name>/feature-description`.
- Every code change goes through a PR — no direct pushes, no exceptions.
- Never reuse a branch after its PR is merged; create a new branch.
- Resolve merge conflicts rather than force-pushing or discarding changes.

### Task Management

- Use task tracking for any task with 3 or more steps.
- Mark a task **in_progress** before starting it.
- Mark a task **completed** immediately when done — do not batch.

### GitHub Access

| Tier | Tool | Use when |
|------|------|---------|
| 1 | MCP `mcp__github__*` tools | Primary — tokens auto-refresh |
| 2 | `gh` CLI | MCP unavailable |

### Safety

- Kill processes by PID only — never by image name (kills all instances).
- Never skip pre-commit hooks (`--no-verify`) without explicit user approval.
- Confirm before any destructive operation: force-push, reset --hard, branch -D.

memories.name: AgentMux Development
memories.description: Stack, build commands, version management, and workflow for the AgentMux codebase
memories.instructions:
## AgentMux Development

Context for working on the AgentMux codebase. Add this bundle to an agent
that works on agentmux.

### Stack

- **agentmux-cef** — Chromium host, window management, IPC bridge
- **agentmux-launcher** — Job Object, single-instance pipe, saga coordinator
- **agentmux-srv** — Async Rust backend (SQLite, agent/block management)
- **agentmux-common** — Shared types and utilities
- **Frontend** — SolidJS + SCSS, built with Vite

### Build Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `task dev` | Development (hot reload) |
| `task package` | Portable ZIP build |
| `task build:backend` | Rebuild Rust sidecar after changes |
| `task test` | Run tests |

After Rust changes: `task build:backend`, then restart `task dev`.

### Version Management

Feature PRs use changesets — do NOT bump versions manually:
```bash
task changeset -- patch "fix(scope): short description"
```

### Logs

`muxlog host` / `muxlog srv` / `muxlog fe` — pipe to `grep` for filtering.

### muxreview Bot

All PRs are auto-reviewed by muxreview (Claude Opus). Address P1 findings before
merging. P2 findings should also be fixed if feasible.

### Critical Rule

**NEVER kill AgentMux by image name** — use PID only. Multiple instances share
the same binary name; killing by name kills ALL of them.
